Contact

Start with the operating problem.

The first conversation is diagnostic in miniature: what the network looks like on paper, what it is actually doing and whether the gap is worth testing.

What to include in your first email

  • The shape of the network or operation—sites, scale and flow.
  • The symptom prompting the conversation—service, inventory, cost, margin or compliance.
  • The management decision that is difficult to make with confidence.
  • Whether you are considering a JourneyIQ Supply Chain Diagnostic, wider advisory support or both.

Email hello@phullinsights.com

Before you write

Please do not send operational files, personal data, patient data or confidential records in the first email. Data scope and transfer controls are agreed separately if the conversation progresses.
